data_window: 2026-08-13 00:00 to 2026-08-16 10:20 Asia/Shanghai. GitHub Search API raw responses were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_16_*.json and selected repository README/content audits under /tmp/radar_2026_08_16_repo_audit/.
source_summary: git fetch origin succeeded on main. Discovery used GitHub Search API queries for repositories created since 2026-08-13 matching AI agent, LLM app, RAG, MCP, AI workflow, browser agent, code agent, voice agent, assistant, automation and copilot terms. Selected repository metadata, README files and root contents were fetched through the GitHub API until the unauthenticated API returned rate-limit 403 responses. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, credential-tested, hardware-tested, donation-tested, provider-tested or security-scanned.
trend_observations: Fresh AI-native product activity is again centered on agent execution infrastructure: repo-local workflow memory and MCP exposure, model/team selection for coding CLIs, web access infrastructure for agents, and governed local runtimes. A second cluster is emerging around self-hosted personal or household assistants with explicit memory boundaries, agent research evidence databases, and browser/image/workflow workbenches. The strongest candidates expose concrete CLI/API/UI paths plus state, audit, policy or human-checkpoint surfaces; thin model frameworks, scaffold-only memory projects and unsafe money-moving tools remain lower confidence.
assumptions: Stars, forks and timestamps are point-in-time GitHub API metadata, not exact growth deltas. Scores emphasize product surface, user scenario clarity, runnability evidence, README/root-content completeness, safety posture and recent creation/update signals. README claims are directional and were not independently runtime-verified. GitHub API rate limiting prevented complete README audits for several lower-ranked candidates; those are treated as watchlist or skipped signals only. No install, Docker, npm, Bun, Cargo, Python, Java, Android, browser extension, model-provider, OAuth, payment, security or production deployment audit was performed.
